game.title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition

roadmap.title: Fast story run (under 30 hours)
roadmap.description: Play the base-game story straight through using taxis and skipping cutscenes so Liberty City Minute is not lost. Date Michelle before The Snow Storm and keep Dwayne safe for later; do not stop for 100% tasks yet.

roadmap.title: Base-game cleanup to 100%
roadmap.description: After the story, finish side jobs, friendships, collectibles and stat achievements until the Game progress statistic reaches 100%.

roadmap.title: The Lost and Damned
roadmap.description: Play the Johnny Klebitz story, then bike races, gang wars and buddy toughness.

roadmap.title: The Ballad of Gay Tony
roadmap.description: Play the Luis story, then base jumps, drug wars, cage fights, golf, nightclub dances and mission medals.

achievements.description: Complete the first mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the first story mission, "The Cousins Bellic".

steps.text: Play the opening mission, "The Cousins Bellic", to its end.

achievements.description: Complete mission "Roman's Sorrow".
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission "Roman's Sorrow".

steps.text: Play the story until you reach "Roman's Sorrow" and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete mission "Museum Piece".
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission "Museum Piece".

steps.text: Play the Alderney story chain until you reach "Museum Piece" and finish it.

achievements.description: Unlock all the islands.
achievements.summary: Unlock every island in Liberty City.

steps.text: Finish the Algonquin mission "Three Leaf Clover"; it opens the last island, Alderney, and unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the final mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the final story mission.

guide.context: A high frame rate can stop the helicopter climb-in at the end of the last mission from working.

steps.text: Reach the end of the story and choose either ending path; both finish the game.
If Niko cannot climb into the helicopter, cap the frame rate to about 30 FPS or lower and retry.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% in "Game progress" statistic.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in the "Game progress" statistic.

guide.context: Progress is shared by many tasks, and a task from a character with several missions pays out only after every mission from that character is done.

steps.text: Finish all story missions (60%).
Complete the 16 random character missions (5%).
Kill all 30 Most Wanted criminals and 20 Vigilante criminals on a police computer (5%).
Finish all 9 assassinations, 10 drug deliveries, 10 Exotic Exports, 9 street races, and 30 cars for Stevie (2% each).
Do all 50 stunt jumps and kill all 200 pigeons (2.5% each).
Unlock the abilities of Little Jacob, Brucie and Packie (5%), and do each activity once with each of them (5%).
Win a pool game, a darts game and a full bowling game, and beat the QUB3D high score (5%).
If you stop near 98%, sleep once or twice at a safehouse so Stevie's last message arrives.

achievements.description: Successfully date a girl to be invited into her house.
achievements.summary: Date a girlfriend and get invited into her home.

guide.context: Every girlfriend works except Kate McReary. Michelle is the easiest and cannot be dated after the mission "The Snow Storm".

steps.text: Finish the mission "First Date" to get @npc{Michelle} as a girlfriend.
Take her out (eating or darts/pool), then drive her home.
Accept her invitation into her home to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Score 3 strikes in a row, a turkey, in 10-pin bowling.
achievements.summary: Bowl three strikes in a row in 10-pin bowling.

guide.context: Bowling is available at Firefly Island and The Golden Pier.

steps.text: Take one full step to the left (hold the move key), then throw quickly. Repeat until three strikes land in a row.

achievements.description: In a darts game score 180 with 3 darts.
achievements.summary: Score 180 in a single darts turn.

guide.context: Dart boards: Dukes (Steinway Beer Garden) and Algonquin (Lucky Winkles).

steps.text: Hit the triple 20 ring with all three darts of one turn.

achievements.description: Beat the High Score in QUB3D.
achievements.summary: Beat the high score on the QUB3D arcade game.

guide.context: Cabinets are at Homebrew Café, Perestroika, Modo and The Triangle Club.

steps.text: Play QUB3D until your score is above 11,000 points.

achievements.description: Complete a taxi ride without skipping from one island to another.
achievements.summary: Ride a taxi to a different island without skipping the ride.

steps.text: Take a taxi with a destination on another island and do not press the skip key until you arrive.

achievements.description: Complete all 10 Exotic Export orders.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Exotic Export orders for Brucie.

guide.context: Orders unlock after the mission "Logging On" and arrive by email.

steps.text: Steal each requested car from the email list and deliver it until all 10 orders are done.

achievements.description: Complete all 10 package delivery jobs.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 drug delivery jobs for Little Jacob.

guide.context: Deliveries unlock after the mission "Shadow".

steps.text: Call @npc{Little Jacob}, pick "Work", and finish the deliveries until all 10 are done.

achievements.description: Complete the most wanted side missions from the police computer.
achievements.summary: Complete all 30 Most Wanted missions on the police computer.

guide.context: There are 10 per main area: Broker/Dukes/Bohan, Algonquin and Alderney. The computer can freeze on "updating" if the target is too close.

steps.text: Use the computer in any police car and open "Most Wanted".
Choose a criminal, find them and kill them. Repeat until all 30 are done.

achievements.description: Complete all 9 assassin missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 assassination missions.

guide.context: Jobs arrive by phone from the Alderney contact, can be done in any order, and are not needed for the story.

steps.text: Accept and finish each assassination job until all 9 are complete.

achievements.description: Come first in 20 singleplayer street races.
achievements.summary: Win 20 single-player street races.

guide.context: There are 9 different races (3 per island); after that they repeat.

steps.text: Call @npc{Brucie} and choose "Race".
Win with a fast car such as an Infernus until you have 20 wins.

achievements.description: Do a wheelie lasting at least 500 feet on a motorbike.
achievements.summary: Keep a motorbike on its rear wheel for 500 feet or more.

steps.text: On a straight road with a Faggio or Sanchez, hold Ctrl to lift the front wheel and ride past 500 feet.

achievements.description: Fly underneath the main bridges in the game that cross water with a helicopter.
achievements.summary: Fly a helicopter under all 14 main bridges that cross water.

guide.context: A message shows how many bridges are left. Pause to see the missing ones on the map for a few seconds. One bridge counts only under a specific arch.

steps.text: Take a helicopter and fly under each bridge until none are left.

achievements.description: After meeting all possible friends, the ones left alive all like you above 90%.
achievements.summary: Raise every living friend's Like to at least 90%.

guide.context: Friends: Roman, Little Jacob, Brucie, Packie McReary and Dwayne Forge. The achievement still unlocks if Dwayne is dead. Befriend Dwayne and hang out with him once before starting Cherise Glover's mission, or he becomes unavailable.

steps.text: Call each friend and take them to activities they offer until their Like is at least 90%.

achievements.description: Complete the story missions in less than 30 hours.
achievements.summary: Finish all story missions in under 30 hours of game time.

guide.context: Paused time does not count. If the clock passes 30 hours, a save from before the last mission with under 30 hours also works.

steps.text: Do only story missions, use taxis for long trips, and skip cutscenes.

achievements.description: Do 5 car rolls in a row from one crash.
achievements.summary: Roll a car 5 times in a row from a single crash.

guide.context: Rolls must happen within 60 seconds, and a high frame rate can stop them from counting.

steps.text: On the airport runway, drive into the yellow ramps so only half the car hits, and keep holding accelerate while it rolls.
Turn around at the runway end and repeat until you have 5 rolls.

achievements.description: Fly on all helicopter tours of Liberty City.
achievements.summary: Take a helicopter tour on each of the 5 Higgins Helitours helicopters.

steps.text: At a Helitours pad, hold F to board as a passenger. You may skip the flight.
Repeat at the other four pads; come back later if a helicopter is missing.

achievements.description: Beat a friend at pool.
achievements.summary: Win a game of pool against a friend or date.

guide.context: Tables are at Homebrew Café and Playboy X's Penthouse.

steps.text: Play pool with a friend or date and win.

achievements.description: Survive 5 minutes on 6 star wanted level.
achievements.summary: Survive 5 minutes with a 6-star wanted level.

steps.text: Raise your wanted level to 6 stars near a subway station.
Hide in the subway tunnel for 5 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete mission "I'll Take Her".
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission "I'll Take Her".

guide.context: This mission has two parts; the achievement comes at the end of the second part.

steps.text: Play "I'll Take Her" through both parts to the end.

achievements.description: Complete mission "That Special Someone".
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission "That Special Someone".

steps.text: Answer Roman's phone call late in the story and finish "That Special Someone".

achievements.description: Capture 20 criminals through the police computer.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 criminals from the police computer's current crimes list.

guide.context: They need not be done in order or in one sitting.

steps.text: Open the police computer in a police car, pick "Vigilante" crimes and kill each target. Repeat for 20.

achievements.description: Deliver all 30 cars ordered through text message.
achievements.summary: Deliver all 30 cars ordered by Stevie's text messages.

guide.context: Needs the Alderney safehouse plus the missions "Smackdown" and "No. 1". The car shown in each message is random.

steps.text: Steal the car pictured in each text and deliver it to Stevie's garage until you reach 30.

achievements.description: Meet all random characters.
achievements.summary: Finish all 16 random character missions.

guide.context: Characters: Brian Meech (3), Real Badman, Mel, Ilyena Faustin, Hossan, Sara (2), Pathos (2), Marnie Allen (2), Eddie Low (2) and Gracie Ancelotti. Eddie and Sara appear only at night; Marnie around noon.

steps.text: Find each character at their map spot after the story mission that unlocks them.
Finish with Gracie Ancelotti after "Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend".

achievements.description: Complete the mission "Uncle Vlad".
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission "Uncle Vlad".

steps.text: Play the story until you reach "Uncle Vlad" and finish it.

achievements.description: Unlock the special ability of phoning for a bomb to be placed.
achievements.summary: Unlock Packie McReary's car bomb ability.

guide.context: Packie is available 4pm–6am.

steps.text: Hang out with @npc{Packie McReary} until his Like reaches 75% and he calls to offer the bomb.

achievements.description: Unlock the special ability of taxi.
achievements.summary: Unlock Roman's taxi ability.

steps.text: Hang out with @npc{Roman Bellic} until he calls to offer free taxi rides.

achievements.description: Unlock the special ability of helicopter.
achievements.summary: Unlock Brucie's helicopter ability.

guide.context: Brucie is available 7am–1am.

steps.text: Hang out with @npc{Brucie Kibbutz} until his Like reaches 75% and he offers helicopter rides.

achievements.description: Unlock the special ability of buying guns from a friend.
achievements.summary: Unlock Little Jacob's ability to sell guns.

guide.context: Jacob is available 1pm–4am.

steps.text: Hang out with @npc{Little Jacob} until his Like reaches 75% and he offers guns.

achievements.description: Reach a balance of $500,000.
achievements.summary: Reach a bank balance of $500,000.

guide.context: The mission "Three Leaf Clover" pays $250,000 and Stevie's 30 cars add about $300,000.

steps.text: If the balance is short after the story, sell cars to Stevie's garage.

achievements.description: You must blow up 10 vehicles in 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 vehicles within 10 seconds.

guide.context: Set traffic density to maximum first.

steps.text: Block a busy bridge with a stolen bus so cars pile up behind it.
Run along the line throwing grenades so 10 vehicles explode within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Complete 10 melee counters in 4 minutes.
achievements.summary: Perform 10 melee counters within 4 minutes.

guide.context: A good spot is near Higgins Helitours: many pedestrians are around and a hot dog vendor is close by.

steps.text: Start fights and press the counter key as an enemy swings, then attack. Repeat 10 times.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of the unique stunt jumps.
achievements.summary: Complete all 50 unique stunt jumps.

guide.context: Counts: Broker/Dukes 13, Bohan 4, Algonquin 15, Alderney 18. Some need a motorbike or boat.

steps.text: Drive a fast vehicle off each jump marker and land safely. Use a map to find the rest.

achievements.description: Collect every hidden package in the game.
achievements.summary: Kill all 200 pigeons in Liberty City.

guide.context: Counts: Broker/Dukes 50, Charge Island 3, Bohan 22, Algonquin 57, Colony Island 6, Happiness Island 6, Alderney 56. Rooftop and airport pigeons need a sniper rifle, rocket launcher or grenades.

steps.text: Use a pigeon map to find and shoot each pigeon until all 200 are done.

achievements.description: Lose a 4 star wanted rating by outrunning the cops.
achievements.summary: Lose a 4-star wanted level by escaping the police.

steps.text: Get 4 stars, then hide in a subway tunnel or outrun the cops until the stars clear.

achievements.description: Help Billy get his bike back. (The Lost and Damned)
achievements.summary: Finish the first mission of The Lost and Damned, "Clean and Serene".

steps.text: Play the first episode mission to its end.

achievements.description: Become leader of The Lost. (The Lost and Damned)
achievements.summary: Finish the mission "This Shit's Cursed" in The Lost and Damned.

steps.text: Play the story to "This Shit's Cursed" and finish it.

achievements.description: Finish the story. (The Lost and Damned)
achievements.summary: Finish the final mission of The Lost and Damned, "Get Lost".

steps.text: Play the story to "Get Lost" and finish it.

achievements.description: In the bike races, whack off 69 bikers with a bat. (The Lost and Damned)
achievements.summary: Knock 69 riders off their bikes with a bat in bike races.

guide.context: Races unlock after "Liberty City Choppers". The count carries across races; check it in Statistics under Score.

steps.text: In a race, ride beside a rider, hold the attack key to raise the bat and release to swing.
Hit them again when they get back on. Repeat until the count reaches 69.

achievements.description: Build Terry and Clay's toughness to 100%. (The Lost and Damned)
achievements.summary: Raise both Terry's and Clay's toughness to 100%.

guide.context: They become available after "Hit the Pipe". Check progress in Statistics under Player.

steps.text: Call @npc{Terry} and @npc{Clay} to help in missions and gang wars until both reach 100%.

achievements.description: Complete all base jumps. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Complete all 15 base jumps.

guide.context: They unlock after "High Dive": 5 target landings, 5 vehicle landings and 5 helicopter jumps. A jump counts if you land at the marked point.

steps.text: Go to each parachute icon and complete the jump.

achievements.description: Complete the Trinity. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Finish the mission "Not So Fast" to complete the Trinity.

steps.text: Play the Trinity chain to "Not So Fast" and finish it.

achievements.description: Finish the Ballad. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Finish the final mission of The Ballad of Gay Tony, "Departure Time".

steps.text: Play the story to "Departure Time" and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete 25 drug wars. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Complete 25 drug wars.

guide.context: They unlock after "Corner Kids" and start at pill icons on the map. Types are convoy, hijack, raid and stash.

steps.text: Start drug wars from the map icons until you have finished 25.

achievements.description: Win the L.C. Cage Fighters championship. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Become champion of the L.C. Cage Fighters tournament.

guide.context: Unlocks after "Momma's Boy"; the venue is in a basement near Holland Hospital, Algonquin. It has 6 rounds.

steps.text: Circle the ring. When your opponent stops to taunt, charge and shove him into a wall or corner until he drops, then attack.

achievements.description: Hit a flag with a golf ball four times. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Hit the golf flag with the ball four times.

guide.context: Golf unlocks after "Practice Swing". Hits show in Statistics under Score.

steps.text: Aim at the flag pole so the ball rebounds off it. Do this four times.

achievements.description: Score 80% or above in all missions. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Score 80% or higher in every Ballad of Gay Tony mission.

guide.context: Optional objectives add up across attempts, and missions can be replayed from the phone after the story.

steps.text: After each mission, check the end screen and replay missions that are below 80%.

achievements.description: Freefall for the longest possible time. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Freefall for the longest possible time, about 16 seconds, before opening the parachute.

guide.context: An alternative to flying yourself: the mission "This Ain't Checkers" starts you higher than you can fly.

steps.text: Fly a helicopter to its maximum height and jump.
Open the parachute just above the ground and land.

achievements.description: Dance perfectly in both Tony's nightclubs. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Dance perfectly at both Maisonette 9 and Hercules.

guide.context: Maisonette 9 is open 9pm–6am; Hercules is open all day. A mistake leads to the bathroom, which is a failure. Capping the frame rate near 30 FPS helps.

steps.text: Go to the lone dancer and start. Press any of the four keys on each speaker pulse.
When "HOLD" appears, hold two keys and alternate the mouse buttons.
Press the on-screen keys in the group dance; 5–6 mistakes fail.

achievements.description: Score 100% in all missions. (The Ballad of Gay Tony)
achievements.summary: Score 100% in every Ballad of Gay Tony mission.

guide.context: Objectives add up across attempts, and each mission's list shows on its end screen. Hardest: accuracy in "Party's Over" and "Departure Time", and taking under 10% damage in "Momma's Boy".

steps.text: Replay each mission from the phone until you have met every objective on its list.
In "Momma's Boy", use the cage-fight push trick to keep damage under 10%. The mission also asks for one crowd hold and one counter knockout.
